data.name: Chinmayee
data.gender_notes: Chinmayee is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Chinmayee is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘chin’ which means consciousness and ‘ma’ which means supreme. The name signifies the consciousness of the supreme self or the deep understanding of the ultimate reality. The name Chinmayee carries the meaning “Consciousness of the Supreme” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chinmayee usually hope their child will grow to embody consciousness of the supreme and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Chinmayee belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Consciousness of the Supreme.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chinmayee total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_sanskrit.name: Chinmayee
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Chinmayee is derived from the Sanskrit word Chinmaya, which is composed of two roots: Chin meaning consciousness or intelligence, and Maya meaning illusion or magic. Together, the name Chinmayee can be interpreted as Consciousness is an illusion or Illusion is consciousness.
